name: Ben Zurcher
title: Director of Multifamily Assessments
bio:
As Director of Multifamily Assessments at Birdsey Group, Ben Zurcher brings a hands-on construction perspective to the evaluation of multifamily properties. His experience across custom and production homebuilding, multifamily renovations, and remodeling gives him a practical understanding of property conditions, scope development, sequencing, and real-world construction costs.

Ben’s work strengthens the Birdsey Standard through practical judgment, quality, accountability, and disciplined assessment.
